description:
Record a supplier bill (an invoice the company has received and owes). Each line needs a spending category and a value including tax.

RECEIPTS: before asking the user for the PDF, search connected email tools (Gmail, Outlook/M365) for the supplier invoice. PREFER filePath (a local file) or fileUrl (a download link) — the server reads and encodes it; large inline fileBase64 is unreliable.

contact.description: Supplier the bill is from — create one with freeagent_create_contact

contentType.description: MIME type. Inferred from the file name if omitted.

ecStatus.description: VAT treatment for the purchase. Defaults to 'UK/Non-EC' — set it for an overseas supplier or a reverse-charge purchase, or the VAT return reports it in the wrong box.

fileBase64.description: Base64-encoded supplier invoice (PDF, PNG, JPEG). LAST RESORT — unreliable above a few hundred KB; prefer filePath or fileUrl.

filePath.description: Absolute path to a local invoice file. The SERVER reads and base64-encodes it — PREFER THIS over fileBase64. fileName defaults to the file's name.

fileUrl.description: URL of a supplier invoice to download and attach. The server fetches and encodes it.

items.description: Bill line items — at least one, at most 40

salesTaxStatus.description: Tax status of the line (default TAXABLE)

totalValue.description: Line value INCLUDING tax (e.g. '120.00'). Must be positive — a supplier credit is a credit note, not a negative bill line.

project.description: Project to allocate this bill to

rebillFactor.description: Markup percentage or fixed price — required for markup/price

rebillType.description: How to rebill this to the client

name: freeagent_create_bill
